record.question: Which of the following is/are correct? 1. Deficiency of vitamin A causes night blindness. 2. BCG vaccine is given to prevent Tuberculosis
record.explanation: Answer C: Both 1 & 2. Vitamin A deficiency can cause night blindness, and BCG vaccination is used to prevent tuberculosis, especially severe childhood forms; both statements are correct. Reference: https://ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/VitaminA-HealthProfessional/; https://www.who.int/teams/immunization-vaccines-and-biologicals/diseases/tuberculosis. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
